snippet.title: Tiny Harbor Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Is your desktop lonely? Tiny Harbor is here to keep it, and you, company💙🎣

Tiny Harbor is a cozy idle management game where you can build and automate your own fishing harbor. Grow your fleet, discover new species and expand your harbor as your little coastal world comes to life, even while you’re busy doing other things.

Wishlist and begin building your harbor today in the demo, available now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4921500/Tiny_Harbor/  

Also follow us on social media to keep updated on our journey! 

🐦‍⬛Twitter: https://x.com/TinyHarborGame
